## [0.2.0] - 2026-10-16

### Added

- Added shared RenderPlan and RenderProfile execution with persisted preflight validation
- Added book-level rendering for ordered RenderPlan variants with safe reuse, partial outcomes, and persisted reports
- Added engine-owned request measurement for Piper, KittenSynth, and InflectSynth preflight and replanning
- Added deferred emphasis composition to RenderPlan rendering
- Added portable Voicefolio-managed PocketSynth voices with pinned provenance and verified audio
- Added SoproSynth rendering with reference voices and Kokoro reference enrollment

### Quality

- Improved output safety with full-scale PCM validation and KittenSynth clamp diagnostics
